extDesc.message: Auto-clicks Allow on Muse (muse.ai) and Codex (chatgpt.com) approval requests. On/off switch, click log, local-only.

statsBarScopeTop.message: Top 12 of $1 topics · share of $2 clicks

onbDemoClick.message: Clicks Allow when Muse shows a clear approval pair

onbDemoBlock.message: Skips anything matching your keyword block-list (delete, deploy, …) while keyword rules are enforced

onbDemoStanding.message: Leaves standing grants (“Always allow”) to you

museTabsNone.message: Open muse.ai so it can run

importConfirm.message: Restore this backup? History and statistics are replaced by the backup's; settings not in the file keep their current values.

importBad.message: Not a Muse Auto-Allow backup file.

importNewer.message: This backup was made by a newer version of Muse Auto-Allow — update the extension first.

importQuota.message: Could not restore the backup: browser storage is full.

importKeyKept.message: Imported. The backup's encryption key could not be verified, so it was not restored (the existing key was kept).

followupCombineHint.message: Tap phrases to combine them — they join in library order

followupGroupSaveHint.message: Add this group's selected phrases to the rotation list

followupHintWaiting.message: Muse is idle — a follow-up is sent once the wait time passes

followupGateNote.message: Enable Auto follow-up to change these settings

followupSendBlockedApproval.message: Couldn't send — Muse is waiting for your approval

followupSendBlockedDraft.message: Couldn't send — Muse's message box already has text

followupSendBlockedComposer.message: Couldn't send — no message box found on the Muse page

followupSendBlockedNoPrompt.message: Couldn't send — no follow-up prompt is set

followupSendBlockedSending.message: A follow-up is already being sent

followupSendBlockedSchedule.message: Couldn't send — outside the follow-up hours

followupSendBlockedDead.message: Couldn't send — the Muse tab is not responding

followupSendBlockedSubmit.message: Couldn't send — Muse didn't accept the message

followupRotateStarterConfirm.message: Replace your $1 saved combos? Tap again

anomalyPauseState.message: Auto-paused until $1 — unusual click activity detected

anomalyActiveNote.message: The detector paused the engine by itself; it resumes automatically.

dryRunNote.message: Detect and log exactly as usual — nothing is clicked and no follow-up is sent.

dryRunBanner.message: Logging only — nothing will be clicked

yoloNote.message: Skips keyword blocks and clicks standing grants. Deny is never clicked.

yoloConfirm.message: Turn on YOLO? Cards blocked by keywords or offering only standing grants will now be clicked. Tap the switch again to confirm.

rulesIgnoredYolo.message: YOLO is on — saved topic and keyword rules are not enforced. Turn off YOLO to apply these rules.

yoloDormant.message: YOLO is configured but Dry-run is on: no approvals are clicked. Turn off Dry-run to resume live YOLO approvals.

allowOnceNote.message: One-time approvals instead of standing access — the narrower grant is safer.

topicsNote.message: When set, only cards whose topic matches exactly are clicked. Leave empty to allow every topic.

topicsEmpty.message: No topics set — every topic is allowed

keywordsNote.message: A card containing any of these words is not clicked while keyword rules are enforced — it is logged as blocked instead. YOLO turns these rules off.

keywordsEmpty.message: No keywords set — nothing is blocked while rules are enforced

scheduleNote.message: Sends are skipped outside this local-time window (overnight windows wrap around).

smartNote.message: Nudges Muse when it looks stuck, and recovers from visible errors. Set 0 minutes to switch the stuck nudge off.

syncNote.message: Uses Chrome Sync (8 KB per-item limit). Lists larger than the limit stay on this device; local settings always win.

anomalyEnableHint.message: Pause the engine by itself when click behaviour looks abnormal (rate or topic spike). It never weakens any rail.

anomalyRateHint.message: Pauses when allow-clicks stay above this rate over a 5-minute window.

anomalyTopicHint.message: Also pauses when one topic takes over the window (40+ clicks and 70% share in 10 minutes).

anomalyDurationHint.message: The engine resumes by itself when the timer ends.

onbStep1Body.message: When Muse asks for approval, the extension clicks Allow for you — you can pause it any time.

onbStep2Body.message: Fresh installs start in logging-only mode: the extension detects and logs what it would click, but nothing is clicked until you turn live clicking on.

onbConsent.message: This tool grants approvals in your name — you stay responsible for what your agent does.

onbStep3Body.message: One tap sets the prompt that keeps Muse working when it goes idle. You can change it later.

missionGateNote.message: Turn on Auto follow-up to run a mission

missionGoliveDesc.message: Contract → audit → execute → converge to GOLIVE READY.

missionAuditDesc.message: Read-only: find gaps, rank them, report with evidence.

missionFixDesc.message: Fix open findings end-to-end, prove each fix, then reconcile.

missionReleaseDesc.message: Freeze scope, verify the artifact, assemble the packet, decide GO.

codexHint.message: chatgpt.com only. Deny is never clicked; standing grants stay manual.

onbLearnMore.message: Learn more — how the rails work

digestRecentNote.message: among the most recent log entries

licenseDormant.message: License activation is not configured yet.

licenseBadSignature.message: This license token could not be verified.

licenseWrongProduct.message: This license is for a different product.

licenseClockGrace.message: Clock moved backward; temporary verification grace is active.

licenseStorageError.message: Could not save the license. Try again.

missionScopedDesc.message: Run a parameterised playbook on a specific project and branch.

missionValueInvalid.message: Enter a valid value; unresolved or unsafe values cannot be sent.

missionUnknownToken.message: This playbook has an unsupported variable token.

missionGuardBlocked.message: This playbook guard blocked the step; progress was not changed.

missionUnavailable.message: The step is unavailable; the mission remains paused.

rulesDescription.message: Block wins over everything. Ask leaves the card to you. Allow narrows what may be clicked — it never widens anything.

ruleDryRunHint.message: Tip: keep Dry-run on while you tune the rules — everything is logged and nothing is clicked.

onbRailLocalLog.message: Every click is logged on this device (latest 50)

onbRailDryFirst.message: Starts in dry-run (logs only) — nothing is clicked until you turn it on

ruleMatchHint.message: Topics + keywords in one row = the card must match both. Several entries in one field = any of them.

ruleOrderHint.message: Order only matters within the same layer — block always wins

scheduleOnlyActiveHint.message: Only send while the Muse tab is open

yoloDryWarn.message: Turning YOLO on also turns Dry-run off.

yoloWarn.message: YOLO is on — keyword and layered rules are not enforced

chartEmpty.message: No history yet — the chart appears after the first click

simPlaceholder.message: card text, e.g. delete the database

trustRails.message: Rails: never clicks Deny · connectors stay manual · standing grants stay manual

trustRailsYolo.message: Rails: never clicks Deny · connectors stay manual · standing grants ARE clicked while YOLO is on

obDemoHint.message: Try it: this card says “invoice”, so the engine would skip it.

obDemoResult.message: Nothing happened — that is the point. A blocked card never gets clicked.

dryGoLiveHint.message: Dry-run is on — nothing is clicked

auditPrivacyNote.message: The file contains decrypted contexts — do not share it publicly.

backupPrivacyNote.message: Backups exclude the log key and the licence token.
